A large '''force''' of the [[Confederacy military]] was deployed to [[Invasion of Saleucami|invade]] the [[planet]] [[Saleucami]] under the command of [[General]] [[Grievous]].<ref name="Mustafar and Other Outer Rim Planets" /> Afterward, the Confederacy remained on Saleucami with the force, which was supported by a [[fleet]] of [[starship]]s that formed a [[blockade]].<ref name="Scarif and Other Planets" /> The [[Galactic Republic]] engaged the Confederacy's forces on Saleucami in a [[Siege of Saleucami|battle]] of the [[Outer Rim Sieges]], which ended in Republic victory.<ref name="Episode III" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Saleucami force was first depicted in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] in the form of wreckage leftover from the Siege of Saleucami.<ref name="Episode III" /> The French release of the encyclopedia booklet "[[Mustafar and Other Planets in the Outer Rim]]" established it to be a large force that carried out the invasion of Saleucami.<ref name="Mustafar and Other Outer Rim Planets" /> Instead of being in the English release of "Mustafar and Other Outer Rim Planets,"<ref name="Mustafar English">{{EncyclopediaCite|Mustafar and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}} {{C|English edition}}</ref> the booklet's section on Saleucami was moved to "[[Scarif and Other Planets in the Outer Rim]]," which additionally alerted the text to frame it as a large force stationed as the Saleucami occupation force.<ref name="Scarif and Other Planets" /> This article assumes the two military forces to be the same unit because they steam from the same paragraph.
